data.name: DialogsDescription
data.value: Modal dialogs: a form with Save then Cancel, an information panel, confirmations opened from code and awaited as a boolean, sizes, intentions, and closing by Escape or the backdrop.

data.name: DialogsSettingsDescription
data.value: They apply to the form and to the information panel of the first preview.

data.name: DialogsInitialFocusDescription
data.value: What holds the focus when the dialog opens.

data.name: DialogsDismissibleDescription
data.value: The cross, the Escape key and the backdrop close the dialog; turned off, only its own actions close it.

data.name: DialogsCloseOnBackdropDescription
data.value: A click outside the panel closes the dialog.

data.name: DialogsShowFooterDescription
data.value: Cancel and Save in the footer of the form. A dialog that cannot be dismissed keeps them.

data.name: DialogsSizeDescription
data.value: Width of the form and of the information dialog, always bounded by the screen.

data.name: DialogsIntentDescription
data.value: Tints the header and the footer, and puts the intent badge before the title; neutral, the dialog carries none.

data.name: DialogsDraggableDescription
data.value: The dialog is moved by its header.

data.name: DialogsConventionHint
data.value: In every dialog the action comes first and Cancel after it, both at the end of the footer and each with its icon.

data.name: DialogsServiceHint
data.value: OmniOverlayService opens them and an OmniComponentsHost draws them. Delete and Archive are confirmations awaited as a boolean: Enter confirms, Escape cancels, and the package renders the button convention by itself. The last two buttons open a dialog that ignores the backdrop and, from it, one that only its own button closes.

data.name: DialogsVariantsHint
data.value: The long dialog scrolls inside its panel; the strict one ignores Escape and the backdrop.

data.name: DialogsSizesHint
data.value: A size caps the width; below 40rem of screen every dialog takes the whole width. A free width replaces the size and can be dropped while the dialog is open.

data.name: DialogsIntentsHint
data.value: The focus starts on the panel, with no ring; Tab leads to the first focusable element.

data.name: ContextMenusDescription
data.value: Context menu opened at the pointer by a right click, or under the zone by the Menu key or Shift+F10, with keyboard navigation between its entries; a click elsewhere or Escape closes it.

data.name: ContextMenusSettingsDescription
data.value: The action chosen is echoed under the zone.

data.name: ContextMenusShowDeleteDescription
data.value: Adds a destructive entry at the end of the menu.

data.name: ContextMenusDisableRenameDescription
data.value: The entry stays visible, and the keyboard skips it.

data.name: ContextMenusDisabledDescription
data.value: The right click gives the browser's menu back: the package's menu does not open.

data.name: ContextMenusKeepOpenDescription
data.value: The menu stays open once an entry is chosen.

data.name: ContextMenusKeyboardHint
data.value: Arrows, Home and End move between entries; Escape closes the menu and gives the focus back.

data.name: ContextMenusRowsHint
data.value: Each file has its own menu; opening one closes the others.

data.name: OverflowMenuDescription
data.value: The "⋮" menu of a row, a card or a header: three dots that open a vertical list of actions, each with its icon.

data.name: OverflowMenuSettingsDescription
data.value: The trigger and the entries of each row's menu.

data.name: OverflowMenuDisabledDescription
data.value: The trigger is inactive: the menu does not open.

data.name: OverflowMenuShowDeleteDescription
data.value: Adds the Delete entry, marked with the danger tone.

data.name: OverflowMenuDisableRenameDescription
data.value: The entry stays listed, dimmed; the arrows skip it.

data.name: OverflowMenuKeyboardHint
data.value: Arrow down or up opens the menu; the arrows, Home and End move between entries; Escape closes and gives the focus back to the trigger.

data.name: PopoverDescription
data.value: A non-modal panel anchored to its button: a click elsewhere or Escape closes it, and Escape gives the focus back to the button.

data.name: PopoverDisabledDescription
data.value: The trigger is inactive: the panel does not open.
